result_preview.title: Production Quality Monitor Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomous agent that monitors quality inspection results and triggers corrective actions.
result_preview.description: This agent continuously monitors QualityInspection outcomes across active ProductionOrders and automatically detects quality deviations. When defect rates exceed thresholds, it initiates escalation workflows, recommends production order adjustments, and logs quality incidents for traceability. It reduces manual quality oversight and accelerates response to quality issues in real-time.

result_preview.title: Quality Assurance and Defect Prevention Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Monitors production quality, automates defect detection, and coordinates corrective actions across machines and orders.
result_preview.description: Continuously monitors machines and production orders to identify quality anomalies and coordinates real-time defect detection across the production floor. Automates quality inspection workflows by analyzing measurement data, triggering automated holds on non-conforming batches, and initiating corrective actions to prevent downstream quality issues. Processes quality inspection records to optimize production parameters and reduces scrap by coordinating machine recalibration and material rework decisions.

result_preview.title: Production Quality and Workforce Performance Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates production order and quality inspection metrics to analyze workforce safety and quality performance.
result_preview.description: This data product aggregates production order execution data with quality inspection results to provide comprehensive insights into workforce performance, safety compliance during production activities, and quality assurance effectiveness. It summarizes key performance indicators across production cycles and inspection outcomes to enable data-driven workforce safety and quality management decisions.
